content.introText: Number Match is a local browser puzzle based on the classic take-ten number game. Clear the board by pairing equal numbers or two numbers that add up to 10. This build starts with a playable LV0 tutorial that teaches each rule with live prompts, then moves into two gated difficulty levels: a shuffled 8x8 first board and a much larger 20x20 second board that only unlocks after Level 1 is cleared.
howToPlay: Start with LV0 to play through examples for equal numbers, numbers adding to 10, and one-turn connections.
Select two equal numbers or two numbers that add up to 10.
Pairs can clear horizontally, vertically, diagonally, across the end of one row into the next, or with one empty right-angle turn when the path is open.
Level 1 and Level 2 each allow three hints per run, and every successful pair draws a connection before disappearing.
tips: Open with the few visible adjacent pairs, then use the empty spaces to reveal longer paths.
On the 20x20 board, work row by row so the large grid stays readable.
If no pairs remain, restart and try a different clearing order.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything to play Number Match?
faq.answer: No, the game is a local browser-based HTML5 build - just open the page and start playing.

faq.question: Does this version use an iframe?
faq.answer: No. The puzzle board, level lock, matching rules, and scoring all run from local code.
